name: Eid Parry
about: E.I.D. Parry (India) Ltd., is one of India’s oldest and most respected companies in the agribusiness sector. A flagship company of the Murugappa Group, E.I.D. Parry is a market leader in the production of sugar, with extensive operations in South India. The company also focuses on bio-products and nutraceuticals, offering a range of health supplements and organic farming solutions. With a commitment to sustainability and innovation, E.I.D. Parry integrates modern agricultural practices with its long-standing expertise, ensuring high-quality products and contributing to the agricultural growth of India while maintaining a strong environmental focus.
